name: hdr-hlg-audio-windows
description: HDR HLG clips that carry an audio track, long enough at 1080p to span several raw extraction windows. Window A: every frame after the first window must be its own source frame, not a repeat (#6556). Window B: the video stream starts 0.5 s after its audio, so the first frame holds until the picture starts, as in Chrome. Neither older HDR fixture has audio, which is why they missed #6556.
